critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Backend Developer and Product Manager must be dedicated (80% allocation minimum) to critical path; Frontend Developer can be shared across non-critical UI tasks with 60% allocation.

tasks.name: Audit existing dashboard architecture and identify integration points for real-time refresh
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture document includes current data flow, database schema, API endpoints, and identified bottlenecks for 15-minute refresh.

tasks.name: Document regression risk assessment for existing dashboard features
tasks.definition_of_done: Risk matrix identifies all existing features that could be affected by real-time refresh, alerting, and scheduling changes.

tasks.name: Design real-time KPI widget refresh mechanism and API contract
tasks.definition_of_done: API specification document includes endpoint signatures, polling vs. WebSocket decision, 15-minute refresh cadence validation, and database query optimization strategy.

tasks.name: Design custom report generation workflow and filtering UI
tasks.definition_of_done: Wireframes and interaction flow document show report builder UI, metric selection, date range filters, and < 5 minute generation target.

tasks.name: Design scheduled report delivery and alert configuration data models
tasks.definition_of_done: Database schema and API design document includes report schedule table, alert threshold configuration, PagerDuty webhook payload structure, and email delivery metadata.

tasks.name: Validate Email Service and PagerDuty integration requirements with stakeholders
tasks.definition_of_done: Confirmation document specifies Email Service API/SLA, PagerDuty webhook scope, and SSO provider integration details; open questions A1, A2, A3 resolved.

phases.name: Core Development (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 1: Real-time KPI widget refresh implemented and tested
Sprint 2: Custom report generation and export (PDF/CSV) completed
Sprint 3: Scheduled report delivery and Email Service integration completed
Core features demo completed with stakeholders

tasks.name: Implement real-time KPI widget data refresh endpoint with 15-minute polling
tasks.definition_of_done: Endpoint returns KPI data in < 2 seconds; polling mechanism refreshes every 15 minutes; database query optimized and indexed.

tasks.name: Implement real-time KPI widget UI component with React and data binding
tasks.definition_of_done: Widget displays KPI values, updates every 15 minutes without page reload, handles loading and error states gracefully.

tasks.name: Implement custom report builder UI with metric selection and date filters
tasks.definition_of_done: UI allows metric selection, date range filtering, and preview; form validation prevents invalid report configurations.

tasks.name: Implement custom report generation backend service
tasks.definition_of_done: Service generates report data in < 5 minutes; supports metric aggregation, filtering, and sorting; returns structured data for export.

tasks.name: Implement PDF and CSV export functionality for reports
tasks.definition_of_done: Export generates valid PDF and CSV files; formatting is readable; file download works in all supported browsers.

tasks.name: Implement scheduled report configuration UI and data persistence
tasks.definition_of_done: UI allows users to set report schedule (daily, weekly, monthly), select recipients, and save configuration; validation prevents invalid schedules.

tasks.name: Implement scheduled report execution and Email Service integration
tasks.definition_of_done: Scheduler executes reports on configured schedule; Email Service API integration sends reports to recipients; delivery logs recorded; 90% on-time delivery target validated.

tasks.name: Implement alert threshold configuration UI and backend data model
tasks.definition_of_done: UI allows users to set metric thresholds, alert conditions (above/below), and notification frequency; configuration persisted in database.

tasks.name: Implement alert evaluation engine and PagerDuty webhook integration
tasks.definition_of_done: Engine evaluates KPI thresholds every 15 minutes; triggers PagerDuty webhook when threshold breached; webhook payload includes alert details and context.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 5: Edge cases and error handling completed

tasks.name: Implement SSO authentication integration with existing provider
tasks.definition_of_done: SSO login flow works end-to-end; user session persists across dashboard and report pages; logout clears session.

tasks.name: Execute end-to-end integration test for real-time refresh, reporting, and alerting
tasks.definition_of_done: Test scenarios cover real-time widget refresh, custom report generation, scheduled delivery, and alert triggering; all pass without defects.

tasks.name: Implement error handling and retry logic for Email Service and PagerDuty
tasks.definition_of_done: Failed email sends retry up to 3 times; PagerDuty webhook failures logged and alerted; graceful degradation if external services unavailable.

tasks.name: Implement data retention policy enforcement (2-year retention)
tasks.definition_of_done: Scheduled job purges report data older than 2 years; audit log records deletions; retention policy documented.

tasks.name: Execute regression test suite against existing dashboard features
tasks.definition_of_done: All existing dashboard features tested; no regressions detected; performance baseline compared against pre-change metrics.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and validate SSO, data access controls
tasks.definition_of_done: Security review document confirms SSO integration secure, data access controls enforced, no SQL injection or XSS vulnerabilities detected.

tasks.name: Execute load testing for real-time refresh and scheduled report execution
tasks.definition_of_done: Load test simulates 40 concurrent users; real-time refresh responds in < 2 seconds; scheduled reports execute without queue backlog.

tasks.name: Resolve critical and high-priority defects from integration and load testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All critical defects fixed and verified; high-priority defects resolved or deferred to Phase 4 with stakeholder approval.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: UAT completed with Customer Success and Sales teams
All remaining defects resolved or documented

tasks.name: Prepare UAT test scenarios and user acceptance criteria
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT test plan includes scenarios for custom report generation, scheduled delivery, alert configuration, and real-time refresh; acceptance criteria defined.

tasks.name: Execute UAT with Customer Success and Sales team representatives
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT completed with 5+ users from each team; feedback documented; all critical acceptance criteria met.

tasks.name: Resolve UAT defects and refinements
tasks.definition_of_done: All UAT defects fixed; refinements implemented; UAT sign-off obtained from stakeholders.

tasks.name: Validate performance metrics: custom report < 5 min, real-time refresh 15 min, alert response < 1 hour
tasks.definition_of_done: Performance test results confirm custom report generation < 5 minutes, real-time refresh every 15 minutes, alert notification < 1 hour.

tasks.name: Write deployment runbook and operational procedures
tasks.definition_of_done: Runbook includes deployment steps, rollback procedure, monitoring setup, and troubleshooting guide for common issues.

tasks.name: Write user documentation and training materials for CSMs and Sales
tasks.definition_of_done: Documentation includes user guide for custom reports, scheduled delivery, alert configuration; training video or walkthrough prepared.

tasks.name: Prepare production deployment checklist and go-live plan
tasks.definition_of_done: Deployment checklist includes pre-deployment validation, deployment steps, post-deployment smoke tests, and rollback triggers.

tasks.name: Execute production deployment and smoke testing
tasks.definition_of_done: Code deployed to production; smoke tests pass (real-time refresh, custom report, scheduled delivery, alert); no critical errors in logs.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from Product Owner and stakeholders
tasks.definition_of_done: Go-live sign-off document signed by Product Owner, CSM lead, and Sales lead; deployment complete.
